playbookOutputs: TCS verification printout / letter showing status Compliant
List of outstanding items if non-compliant
playbookCommonFailures: Outstanding returns (ITR14/ITR12, VAT201, EMP201, IRP6) on any tax type make the status non-compliant
Outstanding debt above the threshold with no payment arrangement
Registered particulars out of date (public officer, address, bank details) so the TCS request is rejected
Client expects a paper "Tax Clearance Certificate" — SARS now issues a TCS PIN that third parties verify online
OTP not relayed within the timeout

informationToProvide.label: Company / Taxpayer Name & SARS Income Tax Reference Number
informationToProvide.helpText: Registered company name or individual full name, plus 10-digit SARS Income Tax reference number.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Company or individual taxpayer name and 10-digit SARS Income Tax reference number.

informationToProvide.label: Reason for Requiring the TCS PIN (Good Standing / Tender / Foreign Investment)
informationToProvide.helpText: Specify whether the TCS PIN is required for Good Standing, Tender, or Foreign Investment Allowance (FIA).
informationToProvide.aiHint: Purpose of the SARS TCS PIN request (Good Standing, Tender, or FIA).

informationToProvide.label: Company Registration Certificate (CoR 14.3) or Individual SA ID
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload the CIPC CoR 14.3 registration certificate (for a company) or SA ID (for an individual).
informationToProvide.aiHint: CIPC CoR 14.3 registration certificate or individual SA ID.

informationToProvide.label: Signed Power of Attorney (optional if using eFiling login)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload signed Power of Attorney if required.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Signed Power of Attorney authorizing My Accountant to request the SARS TCS PIN.

informationToProvide.label: SARS eFiling Username
informationToProvide.helpText: Your SARS eFiling login username (or confirm if My Accountant already has Registered Representative / Tax Practitioner shared access).
informationToProvide.aiHint: SARS eFiling username for the taxpayer profile or confirmation of shared Tax Practitioner access.

informationToProvide.label: SARS eFiling Password
informationToProvide.helpText: Encrypted and restricted to authorized filing staff and the SARS eFiling automation worker.

informationToProvide.label: SARS eFiling OTP Required? (Yes / No)
informationToProvide.helpText: Does logging into your SARS eFiling profile trigger a One-Time PIN (OTP) to your cellphone or email?
informationToProvide.aiHint: Whether 2FA OTP relay is required when logging into SARS eFiling.

informationToProvide.label: Best Time to Contact for SARS OTP
informationToProvide.helpText: Select a date and time window when you will be available to relay the real-time SARS OTP within the 10-minute eFiling timeout.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Preferred date/time window to coordinate real-time SARS eFiling OTP relay.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Collect eFiling access and reason for TCS
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Credentials, registration document and TCS purpose on file
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Ask what the TCS is for: Good Standing (tenders, general) or Foreign Investment Allowance / Emigration (individuals — these need extra supporting documents and are a different request type; raise a proposal if selected). Do not promise a turnaround shorter than 1–2 working days.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Check compliance status across all tax types
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: My Compliance Profile reviewed; each tax type shows Compliant, or the outstanding items are listed
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Tax Status → Tax Compliance Status → My Compliance Profile. Check registration, submissions, debt and relevant supporting documents for every tax type. If anything is red, do NOT request the TCS: draft a client message listing exactly which returns/payments are outstanding and offer the relevant filing services. eFiling login from a new device/IP triggers an OTP to the taxpayer's registered cell/email: pause, raise an otpRequest on the portal job via the OTP relay (Kevin, or the client through the Communication History link if allowed), 10-minute timeout then fail cleanly and reschedule. Never store OTPs. If a CAPTCHA appears, fall back to hand-off mode with the handoff sheet. Prefer filing from our practitioner profile if the taxpayer is already linked as a client; otherwise use the client's own login. If the taxpayer is not registered for the tax type on eFiling, stop and raise a proposal — do not activate tax types without Kevin.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Request the Tax Compliance Status PIN
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: TCS request approved and PIN issued
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Tax Status → Tax Compliance Status → Tax Compliance Status Request → select "Good Standing" (⚠ verify: "Tender" type was merged into Good Standing). Complete the request and submit; the PIN usually issues immediately when compliant. Stage the request for approval before submitting. eFiling login from a new device/IP triggers an OTP to the taxpayer's registered cell/email: pause, raise an otpRequest on the portal job via the OTP relay (Kevin, or the client through the Communication History link if allowed), 10-minute timeout then fail cleanly and reschedule. Never store OTPs. If a CAPTCHA appears, fall back to hand-off mode with the handoff sheet.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Verify the PIN and print the TCS letter
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: PIN verified via the eFiling TCS verification screen and the printout/letter saved
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Use Tax Compliance Status Verification (or the SARS public verification page) with the taxpayer's reference number and PIN to confirm it shows Compliant, and save the TCS letter PDF from the request screen. Note the PIN validity (⚠ verify: 12 months) and that status is live — it can change if a return becomes overdue.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Deliver TCS PIN and letter to client
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: PIN, TCS letter and plain-English explanation posted to Communication History
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Explain that there is no paper certificate any more: the PIN lets a third party (tender board, bank) verify the status online, it stays valid only while the taxpayer remains compliant, and the same PIN can be shared with multiple parties. Offer ongoing compliance monitoring.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Final sign-off
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Kevin confirms the order can be completed
